{{Top}}
[[File:Dumping_fuel.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] dumping Malastarian fuel into a sinkhole on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]]]

'''Fuel''' was the term used for a variety of substances, including [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]], used to power vehicles. In at least some eras, fuels were divided into grades with shipping grade being seen as one of the lower qualities. This kind earned its name from it use in powering the freighters that ran interstellar commerce, but was also employed in other manners. [[Peragus system/Legends|Peragian]] fuel was one such. Mined from the [[Peragus Mining Facility]] of [[Peragus II]], it was notorious for "wreaking havoc with the engines." It was, however, admitted to "get the job done." Another such fuel was [[anthracite]], which was occasionally left exposed in piles.

[[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] was a leading provider of liquid fuel to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the Republic, led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], helped eliminate the threat of a newly awakened [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]], Malastare signed a [[Treaty of Malastare/Legends|treaty]] to join the Republic and continue providing much-needed [[Malastarian fuel/Legends|Malastarian fuel]] to keep their war machine running.

[[Rhydonium/Legends|Rhydonium]] was a highly explosive fuel mined on [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
